title: How to join Project Arena
text:
**Project Arena** is a free VR sport: throw your ball past your opponent's shield, block theirs, and play for your country.

**On Meta Quest**
1. Open this link on your phone or computer, signed in to the Meta account your headset uses:
   **https://www.meta.com/s/4NDP5YlGM**
2. Accept the invite.
3. In the headset, open **Library** and install **Project Arena**.

**On a PC VR headset**, or to watch on a PC without a headset:
   download the PC version from **https://github.com/jendoebelin/ProjectArena-public/releases**

The alpha needs everyone on the newest version: if the game says **UPDATE AVAILABLE**, update it in your Library.

title: Your first match
text:
**Practice:** MAIN MENU > **PLAY PRACTICE** > pick the rules. You play the bot.

**Online:** MAIN MENU > **MULTIPLAYER**, check it says **ONLINE: ON**, then
- **HOST A ROOM** to open your own arena (others can join you), or
- pick an arena in the list to join it.

Waiting outside the tank? Press **JOIN QUEUE** to play next.

**Rules:** BASIC is a timed match. ADVANCED is best of three rounds, first to 4 points.
**Talk:** hold the left grip (push to talk).
**Help in the game:** MENU > **HOW TO PLAY**.

Looking for someone to play? Post in **#looking-for-match**.

title: The Crowd: cheer from your phone
text:
Follow any online match live on your phone, no app or sign-in needed:
**https://crowd.aftersparc.com**

1. Open the link on your phone (Android or iPhone). Live matches show up by themselves.
2. Tap a match to see the score, the clock, both players' flags and their stats.
3. Tap **CHEER** for a side, as fast as you like. Turn on **SHAKE TO CHEER** to cheer by shaking your phone.
4. **WAVE FLAG** puts your side's flag up in the stands.
5. **CALL IT**: guess who scores next to earn fan points.

The players hear you: the crowd gets louder, their end's lights flash, and hearts and stars burst from the stands.
Tip: add the page to your home screen to open it like an app.

title: How to report a bug
text:
**Best way: report it in the game, right after it happens.**
MENU > **REPORT A BUG** > pick what kind of problem > add a short note > **SEND REPORT**.
It sends your note, your settings and the game's recent log, which shows us what went wrong. Nothing else.

**Or post it here.** Please include:
- what happened, and what you expected
- Quest or PC, and your game version (bottom of the main menu)
- a picture or clip if you have one

**On GitHub:** https://github.com/jendoebelin/ProjectArena-public/issues

Good ideas get credited by name in the release notes.

title: Streaming Project Arena (OBS)
text:
The PC version can draw **only the players and balls, with nothing behind them**, so you can put any background behind them in OBS.

1. Start the spectator: `ProjectArena.exe --spectate --layer 3`, or press **V** in the spectator window until the view is **KEY**.
2. In OBS, add a **Game Capture**: Capture specific window > **Project Arena - Spectator**, and tick **Allow Transparency**.
3. Put a background under it: a picture, a video, or one from the streaming kit.

**Streaming kit** (backgrounds, camera guides and the full guide): the streaming-kit zip on
**https://github.com/jendoebelin/ProjectArena-public/releases**

In the spectator window, **F1** shows all the controls. An Xbox or PlayStation controller works too.

title: Project Arena 0.3.7: THE CROWD
text:
Fans can now follow online matches live on their phones at **https://crowd.aftersparc.com**: the score, flags, live stats and careers.

Every cheer reaches the arena: a crowd that gets louder, flashing end lights, hearts and stars bursting from the stands, and a flag in the stands for every fan waving one.

Also new: **SETTINGS > CROWD** to turn the crowd down or off, and strikes now count in your stats.

**Join the alpha:** https://www.meta.com/s/4NDP5YlGM
**PC:** https://github.com/jendoebelin/ProjectArena-public/releases
Bugs > **#bug-reports** | Ideas > **#feedback-and-ideas**

title: The Quest Board
text:
What we are working on and looking at, thanks to your reports and ideas.

**Coming in 0.3.8**
- **Host match options:** shields on or off (HOTDOG MODE), knuckle guards on or off, match time (including no limit), round timers for Advanced
- Hosts can remove a player from their arena
- Smooth turning (a setting, for players and spectators)
- A foul ball bounces back instead of dissolving
- SAVE AND APPLY in the avatar builder
- Push-to-talk that suits each controller (Index, Vive, Windows Mixed Reality)
- Smoother frame times

**On the board** (we are looking at these)
- Body turning, ducking and bending when you dodge; smoother bot movement
- A country banner separate from your outfit
- The arena's look: darker floor and frame, a sky

Got an idea? Post it in **#feedback-and-ideas**.
